what: India's new tax regime (section 115BAC) for income of FY 2025-26 (AY 2026-27), resident individuals below 60
source_title: Salaried Individuals for AY 2026-27 (the page says it was last updated on 9 July 2026)
prepared: From the page, not from the code: the slabs as printed; each slab_tax is the amount the page prints at that bound (for example '₹ 60,000 + 15% above ₹ 12,00,000'), or that amount plus the printed rate on the rest; tax is slab_tax less the section 87A rebate the page states (up to ₹ 60,000 while taxable income does not exceed ₹ 12,00,000), plus the 4% Health and Education cess the page states.
not_covered: Marginal relief just above ₹ 12,00,000, which the page does not state
Surcharge above ₹ 50 lakh, and its marginal relief
The standard deduction, which the page does not state: incomes here are taxable incomes
